text:
Vera: Opening PR to merge scattered Console observability snippets into one focused guide: heatmap wiring, tracehook header fallbacks, and a brief migration note for dashboards. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/17654
DocsBot: docs-bot: PR 17654 opened by Vera. CI + link-check queued.
Noah: I'll take the Node + Python snippets. Plan to show header precedence (trace_key -> x-rd-trace -> x-forwarded-trace) and decoding (base64 then hex).
Lin: I'll do Rust and a tiny serde example; will also show how to safely handle missing trace info and fallback to span_id inference.
Asha: I'll draft the migration blurb for Dedicated customers about the small short-term billing deltas when bucket resolution increases. Include monitoring query sample.
Vera: Example header fallback (Node):
```js
const raw = req.headers['trace_key'] || req.headers['x-rd-trace'] || req.headers['x-forwarded-trace'];
const trace = tryBase64(raw) || tryHex(raw) || inferFromSpan(req.headers['span-id']);
```
Noah: Pushed Node + pytest for mapping formula. Test covers new, legacy, and absent cases.
Lin: Rust snippet preview:
```rust
let raw = headers.get("trace_key").or(headers.get("x-rd-trace")).or(headers.get("x-forwarded-trace"));
let decoded = base64::decode(raw).or_else(|_| hex::decode(raw));
```
Asha: Migration note: dashboards that used single `latency_ms` should now sum `routing_ms + decode_ms`. Billing note: higher bucket granularity can show a transient cost reallocation; recommend enabling `legacy_bucket_mapping` for 72 hours and monitor unit-cost alerts. Example monitoring query included.
Vera: Link-check request after CI. Also update any references to /examples/old-heatmap.
DocsBot: docs-bot: CI passed. link-check: 1 redirect (old-heatmap) and 0 broken links.
Noah: I fixed a minor wording nit and added a short comment about not decoding synchronously in hot loops.
Lin: LGTM on Rust port. Will open a tiny examples-repo PR to add a live sample.
Asha: I'll draft the customer-facing note and add the alert snippet to the migration checklist.
Vera: Plan: squash+merge after redirect PR lands, backport compatibility snippet to stable-legacy, and post short rollout note in #release-notes. Targeting Wed 9am PT.
DocsBot: docs-bot: summary - PR 17654 pending redirect; participants: Vera, DocsBot, Noah, Lin, Asha.
